    About PRINTECH

    A digital printing house that treats every job like a launch: proofed, produced and delivered on time.

    🏭

    Our story

    PRINTECH began with a single wide-format press and a promise to turn artwork around faster than anyone else in town. Today we run a full production floor for flat, rigid, textile and 3D output, with a dedicated colour team and a delivery fleet.

    Clients stay because we pick up the phone, send honest proofs and fix mistakes without arguments.

    • Year 1
      First wide-format press and a two-person team.
    • Year 5
      Added digital offset, labels and packaging lines.
    • Year 10
      Opened the 3D printing and prototyping lab.
    • Today
      One production floor, 80 specialists, same-day dispatch.

    How an order works

      Good to know

      What file formats do you accept?

      PDF, AI, PSD, EPS and high-resolution PNG or JPG. We check every file before printing.

      Can you match our brand colours?

      Yes. Send Pantone or CMYK values and we print a proof you approve before the run.

      Do you offer express delivery?

      Standard turnaround is 48 hours. Express same-day options are available for many products.

      Is there a minimum order?

      No. We print one piece or ten thousand, with volume pricing as quantities grow.
